user.title: Add a TV
user.description: Enable Developer Mode on the TV and set its **Host PC IP** to the IP address of this Home Assistant, then restart the TV.

data_description.host: The TV must be on and in Developer Mode.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the TV. Check that it is on, Developer Mode is enabled and Host PC IP is set to this Home Assistant's IP address.

user.title: Add signing certificate
user.description: Apps must be updated with the **same author certificate** they were installed with, otherwise the TV refuses the update.

tizenbrew.title: TizenBrew Installer certificate
tizenbrew.description: Upload `tizenbrewInstallerConfig.json` (found in `%USERPROFILE%\share\` on the computer where TizenBrew Installer ran).

p12.title: PKCS#12 certificate pair
p12.description: Upload `author.p12` and `distributor.p12` (Apps2Samsung: `%APPDATA%\Apps2Samsung\Certificate\` (one folder per profile), password is in `password.txt`).

error.invalid_cert: The certificate could not be opened (wrong file or password).
error.wrong_device: This distributor certificate was not issued for this TV (DUID does not match).

user.title: Add app
user.description: Choose a known app or a custom GitHub repository and the certificate the app was installed with.

data_description.asset_pattern: Which file of a release to install, e.g. `\.wgt$`.

error.no_asset: No release of this repository contains a matching file.
error.github_error: GitHub could not be reached or the repository does not exist.

abort.no_certificates: Add a signing certificate to this TV first.

no_release.message: No release of {app} is known yet. Wait for the next check or check the repository.

certificate_missing.message: The certificate of this app was removed. Reconfigure the app.

certificate_invalid.message: The signing certificate could not be used: {error}

install_author_mismatch.message: The TV refused the update: the app was installed with a different author certificate than "{certificate}". Use the certificate the app was originally installed with.

install_certificate.message: The TV rejected the signature ({error}). The certificate may have expired or was not issued for this TV.

install_platform.message: This package is not compatible with the TV's Tizen version ({error}).

tv_unreachable.message: The TV is not reachable. Turn it on and make sure Developer Mode is enabled ({error}).

install_running.message: An installation of this app is already running.

download_failed.message: The package could not be downloaded: {error}

checksum_mismatch.message: The downloaded package does not match the catalog checksum and was not installed.

wake_failed.message: The TV did not wake up in time. Check the wake-up settings and that Developer Mode is enabled.

launch_failed.message: The TV could not start the app: {error}

init.title: Wake-up
init.description: How HA-Brew turns the TV on before installing or launching an app. Developer Mode must stay enabled.

data_description.wake_entity: For example the media player of the Samsung TV Smart (samsungtv_smart) integration.
